list.title: Users
list.empty: No users yet. Add a person who needs a VPN — access and the config are issued on their page.

add.title: New user
add.description: Access to servers is issued afterwards, on the user's page.
add.name: Name

errors.conflict: A user with this email already exists.
errors.invalid: Check the email — it must be complete, for example name@example.com.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.description: The name, email and note are visible only in the panel. Issued configs and access don't change.

errors.conflict: A user with this email already exists.
errors.invalid: Check the data: the email must be complete, for example name@example.com, and the name must not be empty.

card.notFound: User not found — they may have been deleted.
card.noAccessExpired: No access right now — the last one expired on {{date}}.
card.noAccessRevoked: No access right now — the last one was revoked on {{date}}.
card.noAccessYet: There has been no access yet.
card.noServers: The term is set, but there are no servers in the access — add at least one.

revoke.title: Revoke all access?
revoke.consequences: All of the user's configs will stop working: the clients will be removed from every server. The term resets — to restore access it has to be granted again.

delete.title: Danger zone
delete.consequences: The user will disappear from the panel along with the access history. While they have working configs they can't be deleted — revoke the access first.
delete.conflict: The user has working configs. Revoke the access first and wait until the clients are removed.

grant.removingClient: Removing the client from the server…

errors.issueConflict: The config is already being issued, or the access period hasn't started yet.

revokeConfig.title: Revoke the config?
revokeConfig.consequences: The client will be removed from server {{server}}: it won't be possible to connect with this config anymore. Access to the server stays — you can issue a new config.
revokeConfig.consequencesImported: The client will be removed from server {{server}}: connecting with its config will no longer work. A new client cannot be issued for this access from the panel.

removeServer.title: Remove access to server {{server}}?
removeServer.consequences: The config for this server will stop working and the client will be removed from the server. Access to the other servers and the term don't change.

grant.importedNote: Config unavailable: the client was taken over from the AmneziaVPN app. The private key stayed in the client's app, so the panel cannot show a config or QR code, and it cannot issue a new client for this access.
grant.importedRevokedNote: A new client cannot be issued for this access from the panel: clients of an AmneziaVPN installation are created only by the app.

grantDialog.descriptionAdd: The servers will be added to the current access; the term stays the same.
grantDialog.descriptionGrant: The panel will create access for the chosen term and issue configs for the chosen servers.
grantDialog.allGranted: All ready servers have already been granted to this user.
grantDialog.noReady: No ready servers with AmneziaWG or a gateway. Set up a server in the “Servers” section.

errors.subscriptionConflict: The user already has active access — refresh the page.
errors.grantConflict: Access to server {{server}} has already been granted.
errors.credentialConflict: The config for {{server}} is already being issued, or the access period hasn't started yet.

period.title: Change the access term
period.description: The access is valid until {{date}} for now.

errors.invalid: The end of access must be later than its start.

config.title: Config for connecting
config.description: The config contains the user's private key. Pass it only to them. Viewing it is recorded in the log.
config.hintLink: In AmneziaVPN: “+” → “QR code”, and keep the camera on the screen — the app assembles the codes itself. Or paste the copied vpn:// key. The .conf file is for the AmneziaWG app and routers.
config.hintPlain: Scan it in the AmneziaVPN or AmneziaWG app on a phone, or hand over the .conf file.
config.qrFailed: Couldn't make the QR code — download the .conf file.

errors.revoked: The config is unavailable: it is revoked, or the client was taken over from AmneziaVPN and the panel has no client key. For a revoked one, issue a new config.
